matchstick.title: Preserve stick orientation
matchstick.principle: When moving a matchstick, keep its original orientation (vertical, horizontal, or diagonal). Changing orientation creates shapes that are not valid Roman numerals or operators.
matchstick.example: Moving a diagonal stick and placing it as a vertical line, turning a V into an invalid shape.

matchstick.title: No addition or removal of sticks
matchstick.principle: Exactly one existing stick may be moved; you cannot create a new stick or discard a stick without placing it elsewhere.
matchstick.when_to_apply: For every transformation, ensure the total number of sticks stays constant.
matchstick.example: Removing a stick from a numeral and not putting it back anywhere, effectively deleting a stick.

matchstick.title: Maintain valid characters
matchstick.principle: After moving a stick, every symbol must still be a legal Roman numeral (I, V, X, L, C, D, M) or a valid operator (+, -, =).
matchstick.when_to_apply: After each stick move, check each character for validity.
matchstick.example: Leaving a V with only one diagonal after moving a stick away, which is not a recognized numeral.

matchstick.title: Verify arithmetic correctness
matchstick.principle: Convert the Roman numerals on both sides of the equation to Arabic numbers and ensure the equality holds before finalising the answer.
matchstick.when_to_apply: After you have a candidate corrected equation, always perform the numeric check.
matchstick.example: Accepting an equation that looks syntactically correct but evaluates to 5 = 8.

matchstick.title: Do not break X or V
matchstick.principle: X and V each consist of exactly two diagonal sticks; after moving a stick, each must still contain both diagonals.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Whenever a diagonal stick is considered for relocation from an X or V.
matchstick.example: Removing one diagonal from an X, leaving a single diagonal line, which is not a valid numeral.

matchstick.title: Answer formatting
matchstick.principle: The final response must end with a line exactly matching 'Correct version of the equation: <equation>' (uppercase, whitespace‑collapsed).
matchstick.when_to_apply: When writing the final answer line.
matchstick.example: Omitting the required prefix or using lower‑case letters, causing the answer to be rejected.

matchstick.title: Do not break I
matchstick.principle: When moving the only stick from an I (a single vertical stick), the I character must be removed entirely; you cannot leave a half‑I shape.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Whenever an I is the source of a moved stick.
matchstick.example: Taking the vertical line from an I and leaving a stray fragment that is not a recognized symbol.

matchstick.title: Operator stick transformation
matchstick.principle: When moving a stick from or to an operator (+, -, =), ensure the resulting operator is still a valid symbol.
matchstick.when_to_apply: Any time a stick is relocated involving an operator.
matchstick.example: Removing the vertical stick from a '+' and leaving only a horizontal line, which is not a recognized operator.

matchstick.title: Transfer vertical stick between I's
matchstick.principle: Moving a vertical stick from an I (which may disappear) can increase another I (making II) or create a new I elsewhere (e.g., after a V to turn IV into VI). Ensure the source I is removed if its only stick is taken.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When you need to change the count or position of I's by relocating a vertical stick.
matchstick.example: Moving a vertical stick from an I to a V, producing a V with an extra vertical line, which is not a valid numeral.

matchstick.title: Transfer vertical stick from '+' to I
matchstick.principle: Moving a vertical stick from a '+' operator turns the '+' into a '-' and provides a vertical line that can form a new I or augment an existing I (making II). Both the resulting operator and numeral must remain valid.
matchstick.when_to_apply: When the equation contains a '+' and an I (or needs an extra I) and a vertical stick can be taken from the '+'.
matchstick.example: Taking the vertical stick from '+' but forgetting to change the '+' to '-', leaving an invalid operator.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model focuses on the visual matchstick transformation and forgets to check the numeric equality of the resulting Roman numerals.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: After forming a candidate equation, convert each Roman numeral to Arabic and confirm the equality before outputting the answer.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model generates the corrected equation but omits or miswrites the required final line.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Always end the response with the exact line 'Correct version of the equation: <equation>', using uppercase letters and collapsing whitespace.

matchstick.why_it_happens: The model removes a stick from a symbol but does not place it elsewhere, effectively deleting a stick.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Track the moved stick explicitly and ensure it is added to a valid location in the equation.

matchstick.description: Breaking a numeral by moving a stick away, leaving an invalid shape (e.g., V with one diagonal, X with one diagonal)
matchstick.why_it_happens: The model moves a stick from a numeral without considering the numeral's required composition.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Remember the fixed stick composition of each numeral (I = 1 vertical, V = 2 diagonals, X = 2 diagonals crossing, etc.) and never leave a numeral missing a required stick.

matchstick.description: Creating invalid Roman numeral (e.g., IIII, invalid ordering)
matchstick.why_it_happens: After moving sticks, the model may produce a sequence of symbols that does not follow standard Roman numeral rules.
matchstick.how_to_avoid: Check the resulting numeral against standard Roman numeral formation rules (no more than three consecutive I's, proper subtractive notation, correct ordering).
